preBaselineDecisions.p3_f7_spec_decision: CONFORMANT - FLOOR EXCEEDED FOR REAL-TRAFFIC SAFETY
preBaselineDecisions.p3_f7_spec_classification: FLOOR (PERFORMANCE.md: 'combined tier arena 256 KiB floor'; 'design estimates ... not measured minima'; 'never silently lowers a floor'); bulk figures are the spec's own '4 MiB/session exposure ceiling; total within 32 MiB infrastructure pool'
preBaselineDecisions.p3_f7_memory_model: per session: 192 KiB guaranteed arena slice (inside the 2 MiB tier reservation), arena <= 4 MiB / 4096 records, bulk <= 4 MiB; globally: one 32 MiB InfrastructurePool (PERFORMANCE.md G partition 'other queues/bulk/worker scratch/control 32 MiB') from which every session's arena bytes above its slice and all bulk are reserved before being held; exhaustion sheds bulk / drops the record as an accounted INGRESS_FULL, never blocks
preBaselineDecisions.p3_f7_worst_case_bound: sessions x 192 KiB (inside admitted tier reservations) + 32 MiB pool; at the engine maximum of 1024 sessions: 192 MiB + 32 MiB = 224 MiB (was unbounded: sessions x 8 MiB)
preBaselineDecisions.p3_f7_code_change: InfrastructurePool (anticheat-packet), ConnectionIngress pool accounting, PacketEngine engine-wide pool, /papea2ac status infrastructurePool line; tests InfrastructurePoolTest (3)
preBaselineDecisions.recording_root_cause: Shard.run marks the session-start rolling capture incomplete (terminal reason DEGRADED) at the first HealthLatch generation bump; on a real client that is EXPIRED - the provisional-outcome journal's 500 ms timeout on the first inbound attempt, guaranteed under CAPTURE-ONLY/UNSUPPORTED correlation because no outcome source exists; the pre-login handshake is already older than 500 ms at bind, so the barrier is at frame 2.
